description: Source code implementing Ethernet MACVLAN management, including object creation, deletion, parameter get/set, and statistics retrieval for a network device configuration system.

methods.name: browseEthernetMACVLANInst
methods.description: Iterates over MACVLAN instances, handling each instance and linking it to parent node.

methods.name: addObjEthernetMACVLAN
methods.description: Creates a new MACVLAN device section and updates dmmap network configuration.

methods.name: delObjEthernetMACVLAN
methods.description: Deletes a MACVLAN device section and updates Ethernet top layers accordingly.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLAN_Enable
methods.description: Retrieves the 'enabled' status of the MACVLAN.

methods.name: set_EthernetMACVLAN_Enable
methods.description: Sets the 'enabled' status of the MACVLAN, validating boolean value.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLAN_Status
methods.description: Retrieves the operational status of the MACVLAN device.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLAN_Alias
methods.description: Gets the alias of the MACVLAN.

methods.name: set_EthernetMACVLAN_Alias
methods.description: Sets the alias for the MACVLAN.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLAN_Name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the MACVLAN.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLAN_LowerLayers
methods.description: Gets the LowerLayers parameter, resolving references if necessary.

methods.name: set_EthernetMACVLAN_LowerLayers
methods.description: Sets the LowerLayers parameter, updating related configurations and VLAN layers.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLAN_MACAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the MACVLAN.

methods.name: set_EthernetMACVLAN_MACAddress
methods.description: Sets the MAC address, validating format.

methods.name: eth_macvlan_sysfs
methods.description: Retrieves sysfs statistics for the MACVLAN device.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLANStats_BytesSent
methods.description: Gets the number of bytes sent via the MACVLAN.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLANStats_BytesReceived
methods.description: Gets the number of bytes received via the MACVLAN.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLANStats_PacketsSent
methods.description: Gets the number of packets sent.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLANStats_PacketsReceived
methods.description: Gets the number of packets received.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLANStats_ErrorsSent
methods.description: Gets the number of errors during transmission.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLANStats_ErrorsReceived
methods.description: Gets the number of errors during reception.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLANStats_DiscardPacketsSent
methods.description: Gets the number of dropped packets during transmission.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLANStats_DiscardPacketsReceived
methods.description: Gets the number of dropped packets during reception.

methods.name: get_EthernetMACVLANStats_MulticastPacketsReceived
methods.description: Gets the number of multicast packets received.
